gaps.sentence: We've decided to do ___ a holiday this year.
gaps.explanation: do without = manage without having something.

gaps.sentence: The doctors pulled him ___ after a difficult night.
gaps.explanation: pull through = recover from a serious illness.

gaps.sentence: An accident held ___ the traffic for two hours.
Don't leave ___ any details in your report.
The new stadium made ___ an impressive sight.
gaps.explanation: make for = produce a particular result (make for a good atmosphere); also move towards.

gaps.sentence: You go ahead; I'll catch ___ with you later.
gaps.explanation: catch up (with) = reach the same point/level as somebody.

gaps.sentence: We had to call ___ the order because the kitchen had closed.
They're ___ up a new office in the old warehouse district.
